scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: Log it in the DeFi Protocol Due Diligence Tracker (Notion) and tick a box only when the step is evidenced, not assumed. Mechanism: what the contracts do; users, assets, incentives. Cash flow: real fees and interest versus emissions. Dependencies: oracles, bridges, admin keys, stablecoins, other protocols. Solvency: collateral quality, liquidation design, bad-debt paths. Evidence: explorers, audits, governance, independent data.
scenes.cap: Mechanism: what the contracts do; users, assets, incentives. Cash flow: real fees and interest vs emissions. Dependencies: oracles, bridges, admin keys, stablecoins, other protocols. Solvency: collateral quality, liquidation design, bad-debt paths. Evidence: explorers, audits, governance, independent data.

scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: Exit: exact unwind, gas, slippage, approvals to revoke.
